basics.name: Terence Fan
basics.label: Software Engineer
basics.summary: Senior backend engineer proficient in multi-language server-side development (C#, Golang, Java) with deep understandings from Linux kernel to language runtime optimization. Proficient in designing high-performance distributed systems, leveraging mainstream message queue(Kafka, RabbitMQ, Redis Channel) systems and both relational(MySQL) and NoSQL(Redis, HBase) databases. Skilled in network(TCP/IP, HTTP/2, WebSocket) programming and building concurrent systems using synchronization techniques (coroutines, locks, atomic operations) to maximize throughput and minimize latency. Experienced in building and maintaining large-scale distributed systems with a focus on performance, reliability, and observability.

work.name: Microsoft - Azure
work.summary: As a core developer of Azure's real-time messaging services (SignalR/Web PubSub), I designed and implemented large-scale real-time websocket services supporting thousands of concurrent connections per tenant and millions per cluster.
highlights: Network protocol design, implementation and optimization

work.name: Meituan-Dianping - Infrastructure
work.summary: As a core developer of ​​CAT​​—Meituan-Dianping's open-source distributed monitoring system—I designed multi-language SDKs (C/Golang/Python), built a real-time dashboard and alerting system, and optimized data collection, while integrating with open source middlewares (Kafka/Hadoop/Elasticsearch).
highlights: Second-level data collection and processing server supporting 100K+ QPS real-time metrics
C library for TCP long connection and MPSC lock-free message queue
Golang/Python/JavaScript instrumentation tools based on C library

work.name: Baixing.com - Infrastructure
work.summary: As a core developer at Baixing, I led the PHP7 migration and microservice transformation using Swoole coroutines and Thrift RPC, achieving 100%+ performance improvements while decoupling core services.
highlights: Microservice based on Swoole and Thrift

work.name: Ele.me - Delivery Business Unit
work.summary: As an early core developer at Ele.me, I designed and developed the SMS system, RESTful API gateway for partners/mobile/web clients, and Thrift RPC-based server that scaled to support 10K+ daily orders.
highlights: Distributed RPC system based on Thrift
Restful API gateway based on Flask
Database design and implementation based on MySQL
